description: Narrow and elongated. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. No internal corridor — fully open layout. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living, kitchen on side wall. Seating: sofa at upper area near dining, facing into the living space; dining table with 6 chairs in the central-left zone. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall opposite wall to entry. Cook may see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is bedroom doors, straight corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Studio apartment. Double bed. Bed not visible from front door, not visible from kitchen. Partial partition — some visual separation but cooking smells and sounds reach the sleeping area. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: singles or couples comfortable with combined living and sleeping space. Not suitable for: families with children (studio with single open sleeping zone); households needing separate private bedrooms; people wanting a home office with a dedicated desk space; roommates seeking individual private rooms.
